title: "plugkit"
subtitle: "The Python port of Cordis that actually works, plus a binding layer that keeps your components plain."

::: {.callout-note}
## Mostly not our work, and it says so

About three quarters of plugkit is a vendored port of
[Cordis](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), the plugin framework
underneath DeepSeek Harness. We did not design it and did not write it.

What this project adds: the finding that **two of the three public Python ports
are broken**, the conformance suite that proves it, a fix to the third, and one
original layer — `provide()`, which keeps your components plain classes with no
framework import.

See [Why plugkit exists](guide/00-why.qmd) and `src/plugkit/VENDORED.md`.
:::

```bash
pip install plugkit
```

```python
from plugkit import Context, provide

class Greeter:                       # a plain class. imports nothing.
    def __init__(self, database, prefix="hello"):
        self.database, self.prefix = database, prefix
    def hello(self, name):
        return f"{self.prefix} {name}"

root = Context()
await root.plugin(provide(Database, "database"))
await root.plugin(provide(Greeter, "greeter", needs=["database"]))
root.greeter.hello("world")          # "hello world"
```

## The one idea

A component adds a route to a shared server, then unloads. The route stays,
because nothing recorded who added it. That is not a missing feature, it is a
missing invariant — so plugkit has one: **a registration returns its undo, and
the fiber that owns your plugin's lifetime holds it.**

Hot reload, dependency-driven activation, and safe implementation swapping are
all consequences of that, not separate features.

## Replaces signalpy-kernel

`signalpy-kernel` 0.4.0 was the previous design — a reactive component
microkernel with twelve decorators. It stays on PyPI and is retired. plugkit is
not a version of it; it is a different design, and the reason for the break is
that 1.0's components had to import the kernel and nothing owned their undo.

The earlier documentation is preserved in the repository under
[`docs/history/2026-08-v1-book/`](https://github.com/bayeslearner/plugkit/tree/main/docs/history/2026-08-v1-book).
